{{Short description|American basketball player (born 2000)}} {{Use American English|date=June 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=March 2021}} {{Infobox basketball biography | name = Devin Vassell | image = Devin Vassell with the Spurs in 2026.jpg | caption = Devin Vassell with the Spurs in 2026 | position = [[Shooting guard]] / [[small forward]] | height_ft = 6 | height_in = 5 | weight_lb = 200 | league = [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] | team = San Antonio Spurs | number = 24 | birth_date = {{birth date and age|2000|8|23}} | birth_place = [[Lawrenceville, Georgia]], U.S. | high_school = [[Peachtree Ridge High School|Peachtree Ridge]]
([[Suwanee, Georgia]]) | college = [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State]] (2018–2020) | draft_year = 2020 | draft_round = 1 | draft_pick = 11 | draft_team = [[San Antonio Spurs]] | career_start = 2020 | years1 = {{nbay|2020|start}}–present | team1 = [[San Antonio Spurs]] | highlights = * Second-team [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC]] ([[2019–20 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|2020]]) }} '''Devin Anthony Vassell''' ({{IPAc-en|v|ə|ˈ|s|ɛ|l}} {{respell|və|SEL}};[https://www.nba.com/news/san-antonio-spurs-2025-26-pronunciation-guide "San Antonio Spurs 2025–26 pronunciation guide," NBA.com, Thursday 18 December 2025.] Retrieved 13 June 2026. born August 23, 2000) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[San Antonio Spurs]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State Seminoles]]. ==Early life== Vassell grew up in [[Suwanee, Georgia]] and attended [[Peachtree Ridge High School]]. As a senior, Vassell averaged 21.6 points and 8.9 rebounds per game and was named the regional Player of the Year by the ''[[Gwinnett Daily Post]]''.{{cite web|url=https://www.gwinnettdailypost.com/sports/peachtree-ridge-grad-devin-vassell-turns-into-super-sub-as/article_de07b60f-ed3e-5fa1-91b0-8ff6735493d6.html|title=Peachtree Ridge grad Devin Vassell turns into super sub as Florida State freshman|first=Paul|last=Thomas|work=[[Gwinnett Daily Post]]|date=March 4, 2019|access-date=January 16, 2020}} Vassell committed to play college basketball at Florida State over offers from [[Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball|Texas Tech]], [[North Florida Ospreys men's basketball|North Florida]] and [[Stetson Hatters men's basketball|Stetson]].{{cite web|url=https://www.tomahawknation.com/2017/5/3/15527554/devin-vassell-commits-fsu-basketball|title=Devin Vassell commits to FSU basketball|first=David|last=Visser|website=TomahawkNation.com|publisher=SB Nation|date=May 3, 2017|access-date=January 17, 2020}} ==College career== As a true freshman, Vassell averaged 4.5 points and 1.5 rebounds per game and led all ACC freshman with a .419 three-point shooting percentage.{{cite web|url=https://accsports.com/acc-analytics/stock-rising-devin-vassell-fsu-stats/|title=STOCK RISING: CAN FSU'S DEVIN VASSELL EMERGE AS ONE OF THE TOP 3-AND-D PROSPECTS IN THE COUNTRY?|first=Brian|last=Geislinger|website=ACCSports.com|date=May 14, 2019|access-date=January 16, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://www.tallahassee.com/story/sports/college/fsu/mensbasketball/2019/10/21/fsu-basketball-guard-devin-vassell-becoming-more-all-around-player/4044390002/|title=Florida State basketball guard Devin Vassell becoming a more all-around player|first=Wayne|last=McGahee III|work=[[Tallahassee Democrat]]|date=October 21, 2019|access-date=January 16, 2020}} He scored a season-high 16 points on December 17, 2018, in a win over [[2018–19 Southeast Missouri State Redhawks men's basketball team|Southeast Missouri State]].{{cite web|url=https://www.tallahassee.com/story/sports/college/fsu/mensbasketball/2018/12/17/trent-forrest-leads-florida-state-past-southeast-missouri/2335915002/|title=Trent Forrest leads Florida State past Southeast Missouri|work=[[Tallahassee Democrat]]|date=December 17, 2018|access-date=March 23, 2020}} Vassell made a three-pointer with 4.5 seconds left in regulation to force overtime in the Seminoles' 65–63 win over [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2019 ACC men's basketball tournament]].{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/florida-state/Article/Big-shots-from-Devin-Vassell-Terance-Mann-help-FSU-defeat-VT-at-ACC-Tournament-130079430/|title=Big shots from Vassell, Mann help FSU defeat VT at ACC Tourney|first=Chris|last=Nee|website=247Sports.com|date=March 14, 2019|access-date=January 16, 2020}} He was named a starter for the Seminoles' going into his sophomore season. Vassell was named the Most Outstanding Player of the 2019 [[Emerald Coast Classic]] after scoring 16 points against [[Chicago State Cougars men's basketball|Chicago State]], 13 against 17th-ranked [[Tennessee Volunteers men's basketball|Tennessee]] and 13 points against [[Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball|Purdue]] in the final.{{cite web|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/basketball-ncaa-pur-fls/florida-state-edges-purdue-in-ot-to-win-emerald-coast-title-idUSMTZXEFC1TBTE39|title=Florida State edges Purdue in OT to win Emerald Coast title|website=Reuters.com|date=November 30, 2019|access-date=January 16, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://www.jacksonville.com/sports/20191125/devin-vassell-patrick-williams-lead-florida-state-to-romp-over-chicago-state|title=Devin Vassell, Patrick Williams lead Florida State to romp over Chicago State|work=Florida Times-Union|date=November 25, 2019}}{{cite web|url=https://www.jacksonville.com/sports/20191129/devin-vassell-leads-florida-state-over-no-17-tennessee|title=Devin Vassell leads Florida State over No. 17 Tennessee|work=Florida Times-Union|date=November 29, 2019}} Midway through the season Vassell's play lead him to be considered as a potential first round pick in the 2020 NBA draft.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/28477446 |title=College basketball picks -- Can Duke or Louisville take charge in the ACC?|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=January 17, 2020|access-date=January 17, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2871395-2020-nba-draft-big-board-who-is-lamelo-balls-biggest-threat-for-no-1#slide4|title=2020 NBA Draft Big Board: Who Is LaMelo Ball's Biggest Threat for No. 1?|first=Jonathan|last=Wasserman|website=[[Bleacher Report]]|date=January 16, 2020|access-date=January 17, 2020}} He scored a career-high 18 points against [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia]] in a 54–50 victory and set a new career high the next game with 23 points and 11 rebounds against Miami and was named the ACC co-Player of the Week.{{cite web|url=https://wnyt.com/sports/vassell-polite-help-no-9-florida-state-edge-virginia-54-50/5611083/|title=Vassell, Polite help No. 9 Florida State edge Virginia 54-50|first=Bob|last=Ferrante|website=WNYT.com|publisher=Associated Press|date=January 15, 2020|access-date=January 17, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/florida-state/Article/Devin-Vassell-named-ACC-co-player-of-the-week-marking-first-honor-for-a-Florida-State-Seminoles-this-season-142493946/|title=Vassell earns first ACC honor for a 'Nole this basketball season|first=Chris|last=Nee|website=247Sports.com|date=January 20, 2020|access-date=January 22, 2020}} Vassell surpassed his previous career high with 27 points while going 7-for-7 on three-point shots against Virginia Tech on February 1, 2020.{{cite web|url=https://www.tampabay.com/sports/seminoles/2020/02/02/no-5-fsu-seminoles-ride-record-tying-3-point-shooting-of-devin-vassell/|title=No. 5 FSU Seminoles ride record-tying 3-point shooting of Devin Vassell|work=[[Tampa Bay Times]]|publisher=[[Associated Press]]|date=February 2, 2020|access-date=February 3, 2020}} Vassell missed a game against [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse]] for undisclosed reasons on February 15.{{cite news |title=No. 8 Florida State survives Syracuse without Devin Vassell |url=https://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2020/02/15/no-8-florida-state-survives-syracuse-without-devin-vassell/ |access-date=February 15, 2020 |work=[[NBC Sports]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=February 15, 2020}} At the conclusion of the regular season, Vassell was selected to the Second Team All-ACC.{{cite web|url=https://theacc.com/news/2020/3/8/athlete-awards-2020-acc-mens-basketball-award-winners-announced.aspx|title=2020 ACC Men's Basketball Award Winners Announced|website=theacc.com|publisher=Atlantic Coast Conference|date=March 9, 2020|access-date=March 9, 2020}} He led the team in scoring with 12.7 points per game and in rebounding with 5.1 per game and was second on the team in blocks (29), assists (49) and steals (42).{{cite web |title=Watch: Devin Vassell 2019-20 Season Highlights|url=https://www.yardbarker.com/college_basketball/articles/watch_devin_vassell_2019_20seasonhighlights_florida_state_guard/s1_15635_31594631 |website=Yardbarker |access-date=March 19, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/florida-state/Article/Florida-State-sophomore-guard-Devin-Vassell-declares-NBA-Draft-145310502/|title=FSU's Devin Vassell declares for the 2020 NBA Draft|first=Chris|last=Nee|website=247Sports.com|date=March 23, 2020|access-date=March 23, 2020}} Following the end of the season, Vassell announced that he would enter the [[2020 NBA draft]].{{cite web|url=https://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2020/03/23/florida-states-devin-vassell-declares-for-the-draft/|title=Florida State's Devin Vassell declares for the draft|first=Rob|last=Dauster|website=[[NBCSports.com]]|date=March 23, 2020|access-date=March 23, 2020}} ==Professional career== Vassell was selected by the [[San Antonio Spurs]] with the 11th overall pick in the [[2020 NBA draft]].{{cite web|title=Spurs select Devin Vassell and Tre Jones in 2020 NBA Draft|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/spurs-select-devin-vassell-and-tre-jones-2020-nba-draft|date=November 19, 2020|website=NBA.com|access-date=November 19, 2020}} On November 27, he signed with the Spurs.{{cite web|title=Spurs sign 2020 first round pick Devin Vassell|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/news/spurs-sign-2020-first-round-pick-devin-vassell|date=November 27, 2020|website=NBA.com|access-date=November 27, 2020}} Vassell made his NBA debut on December 23, recording three points and three rebounds in a 131–119 win over the [[Memphis Grizzlies]].{{Cite web |title=DEROZAN LEADS SPURS PAST GRIZZLIES AS MORANT HAS 44 POINTS |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0022000017 |access-date=February 5, 2023 |website=NBA.com}} On April 17, 2021, Vassell scored a season-high 18 points, alongside three rebounds, two assists and two blocks, in a 111–85 win over the [[Phoenix Suns]].{{Cite web |title=SPURS WIN 111-85, STOP SUNS' 10-GAME HOME WINNING STREAK |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0022000860 |access-date=February 5, 2023 |website=NBA.com}} On February 26, 2022, Vassell scored a regular season-high 22 points, alongside five rebounds and four assists, in a 129–133 loss to the [[Miami Heat]].{{Cite web |title=ADEBAYO SCORES 36 POINTS, HEAT TOP POPOVICH, SPURS 133-129 |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0022100908 |access-date=February 5, 2023 |website=NBA.com}} On April 1, Vassell again scored 22 points, alongside four rebounds and three assists, in a 130–111 win over the [[Portland Trail Blazers]].{{Cite web |title=SPURS MAINTAIN 10TH PLACE IN WEST WITH BIG WIN OVER BLAZERS |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0022101158 |access-date=February 5, 2023 |website=NBA.com}} Despite a season-high 23 points, alongside two rebounds and three assists, from Vassell, the Spurs were defeated by the [[New Orleans Pelicans]] in the [[NBA Play-In Tournament|play-in tournament]] with a 103–113 loss.{{Cite web |title=CJ MCCOLLUM LEADS PELICANS PAST SPURS IN PLAY-IN GAME |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0052100131 |access-date=February 5, 2023 |website=NBA.com}} The loss eliminated the Spurs from a chance to get a spot in the playoffs. On November 4, 2022, Vassell scored a then career-high 29 points, alongside two rebounds and two assists, in a 106–113 loss to the [[Los Angeles Clippers]].{{Cite web |title=GEORGE, CLIPPERS RALLY PAST SPURS FOR 3RD STRAIGHT VICTORY |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0022200126 |access-date=February 5, 2023 |website=NBA.com}} On November 17, he again scored 29 points, alongside three rebounds and three assists, in a 112–130 loss to the [[Sacramento Kings]].{{Cite web |title=FOX SCORES 28 POINTS, KINGS BEAT SPURS FOR 5TH WIN A ROW |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0022200222 |access-date=February 5, 2023 |website=NBA.com}} Vassell underwent an [[Arthroscopy|arthroscopic procedure]] on his left knee on January 11, 2023{{Cite web |date=2023-01-05 |title=Spurs' Vassell out, set for procedure on knee |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/35387388/spurs-devin-vassell-set-arthroscopic-procedure-knee |access-date=2023-11-26 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} and made his return on March 2, 2023, in a victory against the [[Indiana Pacers]].{{Cite web |date=2023-03-02 |title=Spurs News: Devin Vassell to return tonight against the Pacers |url=https://airalamo.com/posts/spurs-news-devin-vassell-to-return-tonight-against-pacers |access-date=2023-11-26 |website=Air Alamo |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |title=Spurs 110-99 Pacers (Mar 2, 2023) Final Score |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/game/_/gameId/401469099 |access-date=2023-11-26 |website=ESPN |language=en}} On March 19, 2023, he yet again scored 29 points.{{Cite web |title=Vassell, Johnson spoil Murray's return as Spurs top Hawks|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap/_/gameId/401469220 |date=March 19, 2023 |access-date=March 27, 2023 |website=ESPN.com}} On October 2, 2023, Vassell and the Spurs agreed to a five–year, $146 million contract extension.{{Cite web |last=Wojnarowski |first=Adrian |author-link=Adrian Wojnarowski |date=October 2, 2023 |title=Spurs, G Devin Vassell agree to 5-year, $146 extension |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/38550908/spurs-g-devin-vassell-agree-5-year-146m-extension |access-date=October 8, 2023 |website=[[ESPN]] |language=en}} The contract signed by Vassell was the largest contract in Spurs franchise history.{{cite web | last=McDonald | first=Jeff | title=How the Spurs’ new $146-million man plans to earn his keep | website=San Antonio Express-News | date=2023-10-04 | url=https://www.expressnews.com/sports/spurs/article/san-antonio-spurs-devin-vassell-gets-largest-18404979.php | access-date=2025-03-09}} On December 15, 2023, Vassell scored a then career-high 36 points, alongside six rebounds and three assists, in a 129–115 win against the [[Los Angeles Lakers]].{{Cite web |title=Spurs 129-115 Lakers (Dec 15, 2023) Box Score |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/boxscore/_/gameId/401584959 |access-date=2023-12-16 |website=ESPN |language=en}} On November 27, 2024, in a 119–101 loss to the Lakers, he became the first Spurs player to make 450 3-pointers in their first 250 career games.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap/_/gameId/401704862|title=Davis and James power the Lakers past Wembanyama and the Spurs 119-101|publisher=[[ESPN]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=November 27, 2024|access-date=November 28, 2024}} Vassell recorded a career-high 37 points in a win against the Nets on March 4, 2025.{{Cite web |last=Kubicek |first=Jonah |date=2025-03-04 |title=Spurs Enjoy Career-High From Core Player in Win Over Nets |url=https://athlonsports.com/nba/san-antonio-spurs/san-antonio-spurs-enjoy-career-night-from-core-player-in-win-over-nets#:~:text=Vassell%20shot%20a%20remarkable%208,which%20was%20set%20in%202023.
